list.label: Model sources
list.empty: No model sources yet. Add one so agents have a model to run on.

models.delisted: {{providerName}} no longer lists {{modelName}}; it may stop working. Select another model.
models.turnOffAgents: {{agents}} use it and will need another model.

refresh.delisted: {{providerName}} no longer lists {{models}}. They stay until you remove them.
refresh.delisted_one: {{providerName}} no longer lists {{models}}. It stays until you remove it.
refresh.delisted_other: {{providerName}} no longer lists {{models}}. They stay until you remove them.

remove.affectedAgents: {{providerName}} models used by {{agents}} will be unavailable until it is added again.
remove.credentialsNotice: Its API key and headers will be deleted from config.json.

errors.unavailable: The host has no model services.
errors.configChanged: The config was changed elsewhere and has been read again. Take a look, then save once more.
errors.invalidProviderId: The name cannot be empty or too long.
errors.invalidConfig: The base URL is not valid.
errors.invalidDefaultModel: The default model is not among the configured models.
errors.invalidNetwork: The proxy address is not valid.
errors.invalidSavedConfig: config.json cannot be read. Fix the file first.

discovery.invalidConnection: Use an HTTP(S) base URL without credentials or query parameters.
discovery.unsupported: This source does not publish a model list.
discovery.network: Cannot reach the model endpoint: {{reason}}. Check the URL, network, key and headers, then retry.
discovery.response: The model endpoint returned an invalid format: expected JSON with a data array. Check the URL and retry.
discovery.timeout: Getting the model list timed out. Check the network and retry.
discovery.http: The model endpoint returned HTTP {{status}}. Check the URL, key, headers and access permissions, then retry.
discovery.configChanged: The config changed elsewhere. Go back to the list and open it again.
discovery.unreachable: Could not reach the model API. Check the URL and the network.
discovery.keyRefused: The key was refused by the provider.
